title: Числа 29 — Numbers 29
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: В первый день седьмого ___ созывайте священное собрание.
cases.translation: On the first day of the seventh month convene a sacred assembly.
cases.explain: The ordinal phrase седьмого (of the seventh) requires the genitive of месяц → месяца.

cases.sentence: В этот день вам следует трубить в ___.
cases.translation: On that day you shall blow the trumpets.
cases.explain: Трубить в takes the accusative; for an inanimate plural the accusative equals the nominative → трубы.
The preposition с (with) takes the instrumental → маслом.

cases.sentence: Прибавляйте одного ___ для жертвы за грех.
cases.translation: Add one male goat for a sin offering.
cases.explain: Козёл is the direct object of прибавляйте; an animate masculine noun takes the genitive-form ending in the accusative → козла.

cases.translation: Add one male goat for your cleansing.
cases.explain: The preposition для (for) takes the genitive → очищения.

cases.translation: Offer a burnt offering as a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
cases.explain: Приятный кому (pleasing to whom) governs the dative → Господу.

cases.sentence: Созывайте священное собрание и не занимайтесь никакими ___.
cases.translation: Convene a sacred assembly and do no work.
cases.explain: The verb заниматься (to be occupied with) governs the instrumental → делами.

cases.translation: This is a pleasing aroma, an offering by fire to the LORD.
cases.explain: It is the predicate noun after это, so it stays in the nominative → благоухание.

reading.ru: В этот день вам следует трубить в трубы.
reading.question: What are the people to do on the first day of the seventh month?
reading.explain: The verse commands that on that day the trumpets are to be blown — the Feast of Trumpets.

reading.ru: Приносите всесожжение из одного молодого быка, одного барана и семи годовалых ягнят без изъяна для благоухания приятного Господу.
reading.question: What makes up the burnt offering for this feast?
options: One bull, one ram, and seven year-old lambs
reading.correct: One bull, one ram, and seven year-old lambs
reading.explain: The offering is one young bull, one ram, and seven year-old lambs without defect.

reading.ru: Семь дней отмечайте праздник в честь Господа.
reading.question: How long is the Feast of Booths to be kept?
reading.explain: The people are told to keep the festival in honor of the LORD for seven days.

reading.ru: Пятнадцатый день седьмого месяца созывайте священное собрание и не занимайтесь ничем из обычных дел.
reading.question: On which day of the seventh month does the Feast of Booths begin?
reading.explain: The sacred assembly for the feast is convened on the fifteenth day of the seventh month.

reading.ru: В восьмой день созывайте священное собрание и не занимайтесь ничем из обычных дел.
reading.question: What is to happen on the eighth day?
options: A sacred assembly with no regular work
reading.correct: A sacred assembly with no regular work
reading.explain: On the eighth day a sacred assembly is held and no ordinary work is to be done.

reading.ru: Прибавляйте одного козла для жертвы за грех, для вашего очищения.
reading.question: Why is the male goat added to the offerings?
options: As a sin offering for your cleansing
reading.correct: As a sin offering for your cleansing
reading.explain: One male goat is added as a sin offering to make atonement (cleansing) for the people.
